title: Named-root binding and unadmitted execution observations accept control and bidi characters in host-supplied workspace ids and revisions
outcome: Named-root binding and unadmitted execution observations accept control and bidi characters in host-supplied workspace ids and revisions
acceptance: named_root_bind and execution_observe refuse new host-supplied workspace ids and source revisions holding the characters the turn_checkpoint path refuses (C0/C1 controls, U+202A–U+202E, U+2066–U+2069, U+200E, U+200F) with a typed refusal, keep valid Windows extended paths and ZWJ/ZWNJ byte-exact, and keep reading stored text as stored; a test covers each entry point

completion.summary: named_root_bind (new names, kind Bound) refuses a workspace_id holding a C0/C1 control or Bidi_Control character with named_root_binding_refused; execution_observe refuses any such new workspace or revision with execution_observation_invalid naming the field. Both run after replay, persist and echo nothing, keep Windows extended paths and ZWJ/ZWNJ byte-exact, and leave stored text read as stored. Tests in named_root::state and unadmitted::tests::refusals; brief in behavioral-control-plane.md. Store judgment: no durable row changes; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
